messages:
maria: :rotating_light: ap-northeast-1 inference pool reporting rapid node churn and KV cache thrash. healthy nodes down ~22%, 95p latency jumped to ~1.1s, error rate up to 2.4% since 00:03 UTC. traces show TCP retransmits + backend timeouts on gpu-infer-*/pod.
ajay: acknowledging, I can see the same from node-exporter and netdev counters. starting a conntrack/ephemeral-socket sweep to rule out conn limits.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-173555 - ap-northeast soft degrade (automated). paging oncall.
maria: adding the quick telemetry: grafana/dashboard/gpu-pools/ap-northeast-1 -> spike in cache evictions and per-token CPU on host side. link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/apn/gpu-pool?orgId=1
oliver: do we want a full evacuation? prefer surgical steer to avoid bouncing users and high cost on dedicated pools. suggest 10-15% gradual shift to eu-central then monitor. keep affinity on for sticky sessions.
leah: cost question — eu instances are more expensive for sustained shift, but we have spare burst capacity there for ~3 hours. can we cap total shifted percent to 30% so we don't overspend?
ajay: plan: do a gradual weight adjust via GSLB API with 2-minute steps. will avoid changing TTL to limit DNS churn. also will start a warmup job to pre-populate KV caches in targets (`jobs/warmkv --targets eu-central-1,na-west-2 --prefixes /kv/prefixes/critical`).
maria: ok runbook says: 1) soft-steer 2) warm caches 3) watch latencies + errors 4) revert if target latencies >300ms or errors +1% over baseline.
ajay: dry-run: ```bash
redwoodctl routing plan --from ap-northeast-1 --to eu-central-1 --pct 15 --step 2m --affinity keep
# plan: schedule 3 steps: 5%, 10%, 15% over 6 minutes
```
ajay: executing step 1 -> applying 5% shift now via `PUT /api/v1/gslb/policies/apn/weights` payload: `{ "shift": [{"to":"eu-central-1","pct":5}] }`

deploy-bot: routing-policy-change: user=ajay env=prod policy=ap-northeast-1 shift=[eu-central-1:5%] status=applied ts=1735554405
leah: monitoring cost alerts; set a soft budget alert at $/hr to flip to NA if spend > baseline+20%.
maria: after 5% we saw latency drop at origin by 12% and error rate down to 1.6%. backend queue length reduced but KV misses still a bit high. proceed to next step?
oliver: proceed. move to 10% next. keep watch on eu 95p latency <= 250ms.
ajay: applied 10% -> policy now eu=10%, na-west=0% (we're keeping NA as overflow later). deploy-bot: routing-policy-change user=ajay status=applied ts=1735554525
sre-bot: automated check: eu-central-1 worker nodes CPU trending up 18%, 95p latency 180ms, error 0.3% (good).
maria: warmup job started for critical prefixes.```
ajay: status update: after 10% shift host-level queue depth down ~40%, client-observed p95 down to 320ms overall for apac-origin traffic. KV warmup reduced misses by ~30%.
leah: cost projection for current steer (10%) is +7% hourly spend, within soft budget. keep rolling but cap at 25% total.
ajay: applying final planned step -> 15% now. deploy-bot: routing-policy-change user=ajay status=applied ts=1735554688
maria: monitoring: ap-northeast errors now 0.6%, p95 260ms. eu p95 remains 190ms. all good so far.
oliver: set an automatic fallback rule in case eu degrades: policy `auto-fallback` -> revert weights back to origin if eu 95p > 300ms for 3 consecutive minutes or error rate +0.8% over baseline. who can add?
ajay: I'll create the auto-fallback entry in the routing-control plane: `POST /api/v1/gslb/fallbacks` body with condition window=3m and action=revert. done. deploy-bot: fallback-rule-created user=ajay ts=1735554760
sre-bot: scheduled verification checks every 30s on: p95, error-rate, connection-failures.
maria: reminder: keep dedicated pools exempt from steering to avoid SLA surprises. updated steer rules with tag `dedicated:false`.
leah: good. also enable short TTL for the canary set to 60s? we previously avoided TTL churn; tradeoffs?
oliver: prefer to keep DNS TTL=120s for stability — we already did gradual steps. lowering TTL now risks extra churn. leave at 120s.
ajay: agreed. final status at 1735554900 snapshot: ap-northeast healthy nodes back to -8% (improved), errors 0.5%, p95 240ms. eu CPU at +22% but within capacity.
maria: leaving monitoring on for another 30m, will close incident when errors <0.5% and node count stable for 15m. thanks team. :thumbsup:
sre-bot: Incident INC-2024-173555 status=mitigating assignees=[maria,ajay] lastupdate=1735554980
